大家好，不知道大家这周过的怎么样，我又回来分享我生成的图片了。我每次尽量跑够40张图再发（估计应该一周一次），目前的风格是每个场景尽量都能体现一种故事感，不知道大家能不能对上我的电波。这次的作品含“孕”量比较高，其实是我有点偷懒，想不出来题材就加个孕肚很爽。最近又感冒了，大家也注意身体，多喝热水。

讨论组（仅限AI生成内容）：https://t.me/+EUtHg-NUEec1NjI1
更新通知频道：https://t.me/+sgcq5sdnYMZjMmU1

------

Hello everyone, I hope you've all had a good week. I'm back again to share the images I've generated. I try to generate at least 40 images before each post (usually about once a week).My current style aims for each scene to carry its own story, curious if this wavelength(denpa) of mine reaches you.
This time, there's a higher 'pregnancy' theme. That's because I got lazy – if a scene didn't inherently have a strong story, adding a pregnant belly just instantly brings one to life. I've caught a cold again recently, so please everyone take care and stay healthy.

Discussion Group (AI-generated content only): https://t.me/+EUtHg-NUEec1NjI1
Update notifications channel: https://t.me/+sgcq5sdnYMZjMmU1

The uncompressed images from each run are packaged and shared in the group. Also, any good images I generate in between full posts will be shared in the group first.
